head: codex/191-secure-durable-openraft
title: [v0.92][WP-04.16a] Secure and durably persist three-voter OpenRaft transport
body:
Closes #191

## Summary
- register the production Polis runtime through the normal distributed crate surface
- bind route authority to the trusted deployment bootstrap and exact accepted membership lineage
- retain failed outbound requests for exact retry and serialize durable replay dispatch across replacement connections
- isolate replay state by the complete Polis, domain, identity, generation, and membership namespace
- reject independently configured same-index authority replacement
- retain merge-safe proof covering compatibility harnesses, 14/14 serial tests, strict Clippy, and the full workspace compile

## Validation
- `cargo nextest run --locked --manifest-path adl-runtime/Cargo.toml --test distributed_runtime_transport --no-tests=fail --test-threads=1` (14 passed, 0 skipped)
- `cargo clippy --locked --manifest-path adl-runtime/Cargo.toml --test distributed_runtime_transport -- -D warnings`
- `cargo test --locked --manifest-path adl-runtime/Cargo.toml --workspace --no-run`
- canonical issue #191 v5 receipt validator
- independent exact-head review: APPROVE, no actionable P0-P3 findings

This PR remains intentionally unmerged pending operator and external review.
